strongestFixedDecorationCounterexample.statement: For every fixed jet order N, an order-(N+1) contact family has two arcs with identical N-jets and different finite eliminated limits.
strongestFixedDecorationCounterexample.consequence: No uniform finite normal-decoration vocabulary makes all unbounded-order rank changes single-valued.

analyticBoundaryCounterexample.statement: Smooth flat D and B can have identical infinite Taylor jets while their quotient has different finite limits.
analyticBoundaryCounterexample.consequence: Analyticity is substantive; a jet-only dispatcher must not claim the smooth category.

branches.boundedDiscriminant: imaginary-part identity, null-regulator independence and frame covariance
principal part of the full meromorphic Schur correction
cluster set of the correction on admitted approach arcs
branches.dispositionImpact: unique value iff constant finite arc functor; otherwise retain arc-groupoid output

branches.boundedDiscriminant: same finite jet with different finite response
branches.dispositionImpact: no fixed finite jet is complete over unbounded contact order

branches.boundedDiscriminant: loop transport of quadratic residue versus oriented eigenline
branches.dispositionImpact: passive carrier descends; orientation/grading remains a local-system decoration
measure representation preserves each passive branch but cannot equate distinct branches

branches.boundedDiscriminant: flat germs with identical Taylor series and different corrections
branches.dispositionImpact: jet calculus cannot silently extend beyond analytic germs
new operator-theoretic programme; cannot alter the bounded theorem

branches.boundedDiscriminant: model-specific existence, renormalization and fluctuation relations
branches.dispositionImpact: application programmes, not missing cases of the carrier theorem

finalDispatcher.condition: rank change and the full correction has one finite cluster value
rank change and finite cluster values depend on the approach arc
finalDispatcher.output: arc-groupoid-valued response; do not descend to one value

finalDispatcher.condition: the correction is unbounded along at least one admitted arc
finalDispatcher.output: retain the interior or refuse elimination

finalDispatcher.condition: a normal coordinate and subtraction prescription are explicit decorations
finalDispatcher.output: scheme-relative renormalized response with the scheme retained in its type

boundedExhaustion.declaredScope: finite-dimensional analytic or polynomial block-response germs near a rank-changing locus
boundedExhaustion.reason: Within the declared finite-dimensional analytic/polynomial scope, every crossing is classified by whether the full correction has one finite cluster value, multiple finite cluster values, or an unbounded value. Further resolution algorithms can refine arc labels but cannot change these three dispositions.
